messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - elevated 504 rate in eu-west1 edge pool. Aggregated 504s from gateway->mlworker pipeline above 8% in 5m.

maya: paging eu on-call, this looks like increased timeouts to the NAT gateway in eu-west1. seeing connection resets in proxy logs.

samir: i'm on it. pulling logs from edgeproxy-*/eu-west1. can someone post the dashboard link?

ops_sre: dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/edge-eu?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now :chart_with_upwards_trend:

nora: +1, several customers in EU reporting 502/504s, support ticket queue spiked. triage tag applied.

maya: oncall-ml, please confirm model-worker error rates. are we fallback-ing to us-east? any rate-limit triggers?

oncall-ml: ml-workers eu-west1 showing KV cache misses and gRPC timeouts to storage backend. yes some requests are routing to us-east-standby pool due to failed healthchecks. rate limiter tripped for a subset of traffic -> 429s observed.

samir: copying runbook steps: `edge-failover-runbook.md` quick plan: 1) isolate affected edgepool, 2) divert new sessions to warm standby, 3) scale standby, 4) remediate NAT/infra.

maya: executing step 1: marking edgepool eu-west1-edge-a as draining in router: `rbacctl set pool eu-west1-edge-a --state=draining` -- will prevent new sessions.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by maya: rolling restart edgeproxy-eu-west1 (3 nodes). CI pipeline id: #8732

ops_sre: also bumping standby pool capacity: `infra-cli scale pool eu-standby 6` to absorb traffic. doing healthchecks.

nora: support-brianna please prep customer msg: which customers impacted? prioritize enterprise tenants in EU.

support-brianna: pulling ticket list now. affected: AcmeCorp, Healthlytics-EU, ShopBox. drafting: "We're investigating increased timeouts in EU, working on mitigation. ETA 30-45m." will paste draft here.

samir: logs show repeated `connect: connection reset by peer` from edgeproxy -> nat-gateway-eu1. opening ticket with cloud provider and pinging network team.

ops_sre: temporary mitigation: enabling proxy-level retry/backoff for 5xx on ingress to reduce 504s while we drain: `config set proxy.ingress.retry_on_5xx true --timeout=2s` applied to eu-router.

oncall-ml: confirming fallback routes are throttled. Increasing per-customer concurrency caps for affected tenants to reduce 429s: `quota set AcmeCorp concurrency 25`.

maya: rolling restart complete on 3/3 nodes. preliminary 5m window shows errors down from 8% -> 3.2% but still above normal.

samir: provider confirmed transient NAT translations exhausted, they restarted the NAT appliance. we still need to validate no lingering connections.

ops_sre: running `ss -tanp | grep nat | wc -l` across proxies, results look normal. continuing to monitor.

nora: support update ready: "Mitigation in progress: we've drained the affected edgepool and rerouted traffic to standby. Some customers may still experience errors; we'll follow up."

support-brianna: message sent to priority tenants and posted in SSO incident page.

maya: next steps: keep standby scaled for 30m, monitor error rate, if stable <1% we can un-drain and rotate traffic back gradually.

oncall-ml: also kick a check on model-worker KV cache warmup; triggering cache prewarm for hot models to reduce cold-starts.

samir: will coordinate with network team for postmortem. tagging for handoff to night-shift at 02:00 UTC.

ops_sre: adding postmortem task: `investigate NAT scaling, improve sentinel alerts for conntrack`, and `automate pool draining on nat saturation`.

maya: handing off to night oncall: @nora will lead, @samir backup. leaving summary:
- initial issue: NAT connection exhaustion in eu-west1 causing proxy->mlworker timeouts -> increased 504s
- impact: partial degradation for EU tenants, some fallbacks to us-east and 429s
- mitigations: drained pool, scaled standby, restarted proxies, enabled retry/backoff, vendor NAT restart
- customer comms: priority notified

nora: ack. taking over. will monitor for 2h and own postmortem + RCA.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> monitoring. runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infraincidents/eu-nat-504-2026

maya: thanks all. great coordination. :thumbsup:
